history.summary: The Durga Bhawan Mandir is one of Rohtak's most prominent city temples, dedicated to Goddess Durga, standing on Delhi Road (the NH-9/NH-10 corridor) near the Old Bus Stand / Model Town in central Rohtak. It is a large, well-attended temple (4.6 rating, ~669 reviews on JustDial) that is decked out for the nine-day Navratri festival, drawing worshippers from across the city and beyond (per MakeMyTrip). No published source gives a founding date or builder - it is a modern temple and its antiquity is unverified. CONFLICT (verify): published opening hours disagree - JustDial lists 10:00 AM - 9:00 PM (Mon-Sat), while Instagram place data lists 5:00 AM - 9:30 PM daily.

town_description: Rohtak is a major city in Haryana, about 70 km northwest of Delhi on NH-9. Tradition names it after Raja Rohtash, under whom the city is said to have been built; it is one of the seven districts created when Haryana was formed in 1966. Today Rohtak is an educational, medical and commercial hub of the state, with ancient finds reported from nearby sites such as Rukhi.
